modules.title: Check-in and airport cutoffs
modules.lede: Southwest may begin boarding as early as 30 minutes before scheduled departure.

boarding_start.value: Boarding may begin as early as 30 minutes before scheduled departure; Southwest encourages passengers to be in the gate area by then.

gate_cutoff.value: All passengers must have their boarding passes and be in the gate area at least 10 minutes before scheduled departure, or Southwest may cancel the reservation and you will not be eligible for denied boarding compensation.

no_show.value: If you are not travelling, cancel at least 10 minutes before the original scheduled departure time; otherwise the reservation is cancelled and funds and points may be forfeited.

phone_home_market.notes: Southwest Airlines official customer support line.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are standards published by the carrier for delays and cancellations. On codeshares or interline itineraries, the operating carrier is responsible.

care.value: When a flight is delayed or cancelled within carrier control, passengers are entitled to meals, refreshments, communication access, and hotel accommodation with transport for overnight delays.

rebooking_refund.value: For disruptions within carrier control, the airline rebooks passengers on the next available flight or provides a full refund for unused flight segments if delayed by 3 hours or more.

compensation.value: Statutory or policy compensation applies for cancellations or long delays within carrier control according to applicable aviation passenger rights regulations.

fare_name.value: Wanna Get Away: 1 carry-on bag, 1 personal item, and 2 checked bags up to 50 lbs each INCLUDED

seat_selection_included.value: Open seating system based on boarding position group (A, B, C); no assigned seat numbers

change_cancellation_policy.value: No change fees; reusable flight credit for cancellations made at least 10 minutes prior to departure
